verdict.rationale: Luma documents a public API at docs.lumalabs.ai, with self-serve API keys and billing on platform.lumalabs.ai. It offers reasoning and generation endpoints with Python/JS/TS SDKs and credit-based pay-per-use pricing. The docs are agent-friendly: there is a live llms.txt, and every docs page has a markdown version. Missing for 10: no machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec was found at the probed paths, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of driving the product through the API.
